entries.summary: In the context of SSE streams that the backend closes on purpose, facing a spurious "Reconnecting" banner on every stop, we decided that terminal frames mark the connection non-reconnecting synchronously inside the frame dispatcher, to achieve a quiet disconnect that cannot race the React render cycle, accepting that every new terminal frame type must be added to that branch by hand.
